About Writing Data Contact

I'm a Chicago-raised, Florida and Paris-trained business professional with an M.A. in Global Communications from The American University of Paris and a B.S. in Business Administration from Florida A&M University. My interests lie at the intersection of sport, culture, and global business focusing on how leagues, brands, and cities use storytelling to cross borders.

I've aided community programming for the Chicago Bulls, managed digital and print communications for a U.S. House of Representatives office as well as multi-channel content strategies for the Women's Business Enterprise National Council, and contributed to digital content and communications of the Muhammad Ali Center.

These articles and projects are from my time in Paris completing the following courses of my program: Digital Media Writing Practicum, Digital Tools in Context, Politics & Economics of Global Media.
